structures.title: Bachelor of Data Science Second Major Options

semesters.name: Business Data Science (DS01SMJ-BUSDATA)

units.title: Game Theory and Simulation for Decision-Making

notes: The Business Data Science (BDS) Second Major consists of strategies, methodologies, fundamental techniques & core technologies that enterprises use for data-driven decision-making. BDS addresses a variety of concerns, including products, services, processes and resources. Businesses require continuous monitoring, reporting, predicting & optimising to stay competitive & drive innovations. The core tasks of BDS include data sourcing, ingestion, aggregation, quality management, analysis, visualisation & decision support, which are supported by data science & AI techniques. BDS technologies include high-scale, in-memory databases, extract-transform-load tools & enriched data visualisation tools, offered by leading players such as SAP, Microsoft, Google and Amazon, and leveraged across all sectors of the economy. To ensure that the use of BDS & AI is effective & responsible, robust enterprise governance frameworks must be in place to direct & control BDS functions & data in an organisation.
Select 24 credit points (two units) from the Option Units List in the Business Data Science Second Major
Note: IAB321 is permitted to count as an option unit towards this course if completed in 2026 or prior.

semesters.name: Data and Decision Analytics (DS01SMJ-DATADEC)
notes: The Data and Decision Analytics second major provides you with the knowledge and skills to analyse, model, visualise, support decision and optimise decisions over a wide range of data types and problem contexts. Reflective of the breadth of data analytics roles in industry, you have the opportunity to focus on state-of-the-art, advanced methods in the stochastic analytics strand, or on broad techniques and applications of data to support decisions in the applied analytics strand. Your well-developed written, oral and visual communication skills will manifest in a strong presence and clarity of voice when communicating and justifying design decisions, solutions and recommendations to stakeholders.
Applied Analytics Strand
Select 12 credit points (one unit) from the Option Units List 1 in Applied Analytics Strand
Select 24 credit points (two units) from the Option Units List 2 in Applied Analytics Strand
Stochastic Analytics Strand
Select 12 credit points (one unit) from the Option Units List 1 in Stochastic Analytics

Select 12 credit points (one unit) from the Option Units List 2 in Stochastic Analytics. Students who have not completed MXB105 as a part of Bachelor of Data Science Core Unit Options List 1 (Maths), must select MXB105 now.

semesters.name: Business Data Science (DS01SMJ-BUSDATA)

units.title: Game Theory and Simulation for Decision-Making

notes: The Business Data Science (BDS) Second Major consists of strategies, methodologies, fundamental techniques & core technologies that enterprises use for data-driven decision-making. BDS addresses a variety of concerns, including products, services, processes and resources. Businesses require continuous monitoring, reporting, predicting & optimising to stay competitive & drive innovations. The core tasks of BDS include data sourcing, ingestion, aggregation, quality management, analysis, visualisation & decision support, which are supported by data science & AI techniques. BDS technologies include high-scale, in-memory databases, extract-transform-load tools & enriched data visualisation tools, offered by leading players such as SAP, Microsoft, Google and Amazon, and leveraged across all sectors of the economy. To ensure that the use of BDS & AI is effective & responsible, robust enterprise governance frameworks must be in place to direct & control BDS functions & data in an organisation.
Select 24 credit points (two units) from the Option Units List in the Business Data Science Second Major
Note: IAB321 is permitted to count as an option unit towards this course if completed in 2026 or prior.

semesters.name: Data and Decision Analytics (DS01SMJ-DATADEC)
notes: The Data and Decision Analytics second major provides you with the knowledge and skills to analyse, model, visualise, support decision and optimise decisions over a wide range of data types and problem contexts. Reflective of the breadth of data analytics roles in industry, you have the opportunity to focus on state-of-the-art, advanced methods in the stochastic analytics strand, or on broad techniques and applications of data to support decisions in the applied analytics strand. Your well-developed written, oral and visual communication skills will manifest in a strong presence and clarity of voice when communicating and justifying design decisions, solutions and recommendations to stakeholders.
Applied Analytics Strand
Select 12 credit points (one unit) from the Option Units List 1 in Applied Analytics Strand
Select 24 credit points (two units) from the Option Units List 2 in Applied Analytics Strand
Stochastic Analytics Strand
Select 12 credit points (one unit) from the Option Units List 1 in Stochastic Analytics

Select 12 credit points (one unit) from the Option Units List 2 in Stochastic Analytics. Students who have not completed MXB105 as a part of Bachelor of Data Science Core Unit Options List 1 (Maths), must select MXB105 now.

semesters.name: Scenography (KKFAMNR-SCENEGR)
notes: Description: This minor will provide you with the practical and theoretical skills associated with the creation of scenography for theatre and live performance. You will investigate some of the theatrical and cultural shifts throughout history that underpin current approaches to design for theatre, dance, opera and contemporary live performance. Your study will include practical investigation into the step-by-step theatre design process, including textual analysis and communication of design concepts, and realised performance projects.
Note: This minor is only available to students from Creative Industries single degrees and IF27 students.

semesters.name: Social Media Strategy (KCBXMNR-SOCMEDS)
notes: Select 24cp from the Social Media Strategy minor core options list:

semesters.name: Strategic Communication for the Professions (KCBXMNR-STRPROF)
notes: Description: Strategic Communication is a versatile minor that equips you with the skills to communicate effectively in a variety of organisational and professional settings. The minor prepares you to conceive, prepare, and deliver functional communication forms, like briefings and reports, and more persuasive messages, like strategic speech writing and delivery. You learn how to use communication to influence opinion, adapt messages for different audiences, and critically evaluate the effectiveness of different communication tools, platforms, and approaches. The minor is a great complement to any study plan as communication skills and strategic thinking are highly sought after by employers in any industry.

semesters.name: Architectural Studies (DEBXMNR-ARCSTUD - version 2): discontinued end 2023
notes: Description: This minor will introduce you to architectural practices and knowledge and may complement your own discipline and allow you to work more effectively with architects in professional practice.
*Note: DAB101, DAB102, DAB200, DAB211, DYB111, DYB112, DYB113 and DYB114 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2023 or earlier.

semesters.name: Art and Design History (KKBXMNR-ARTDESH): discontinued end 2024
notes: Description: This minor introduces you to the essential principles of visual and textual literacy. You will develop the fundamental skills of learning, discussing and writing about the history and theory of visual art, architecture and design and understand the historical and contextual frameworks of creative practice in these fields.
*Note: KVB102 and KVB113 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.

semesters.name: CGI (KKBXMNR-CGENI): discontinued end 2024
notes: Description: This introduces you to the theories and production methods associated with 3D computer generated imagery and animation. It will provide you with a theoretical understanding and practical ability to create CGI Assets, Worlds and Creatures while also building your understanding of CGI production processes and problem solving.
*Note: KNB127 and KNB137 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.

semesters.name: Character Animation (KKBXMNR-CHARANI): discontinued end 2024
notes: Description: In this minor you will be introduced to the methods, principles and processes employed in creating 3D animation for action and character acting in a narrative context. You will gain an understanding of contemporary animation production technologies underpinned by the historical context of the medium.
*Note: KNB125 and KNB135 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.

semesters.name: Communication for the Professions (KKBXMNR-COMNPRF): discontinued end 2023
notes: Description: This minor provides you with an overview of the skills and knowledge needed for professional communication practitioners.
*Note: CWB102 is permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.
*Note: CCB102, CCB203, CCB204, CWB301 and CYB101 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2023 or earlier.

semesters.name: Creative Writing (KKBXMNR-CRWRTG): discontinued end 2024

units.title: The Artful Life: From Memoir to Fiction

notes: Description: This minor aims to prepare you with practical skills and technical competence in the area of creative writing across a number of forms and genres.
*Note: CWB112 is permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2023 or earlier.

semesters.name: Dance (KKBXMNR-DANCE): discontinued end 2024
notes: Description: This minor provides the opportunity to approach dance as a subject for critical, analytical and contextual study.
*Note: KDB113 and KDB122 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.

semesters.name: Design and Visual Storytelling for Animation (KKBXMNR-DESVSAN): discontinued end 2024
notes: Description: This will introduce you to story development, design and pre-visualisation techniques for visual storytelling productions such as animated films. You will develop essential motion design and editing skills required for pre-production process. While focused on animation, the core principles and skills being taught apply to games and live action film development as well.
*Note: KNB126 and KNB136 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.

semesters.name: Digital Media and Audience Research (KKBXMNR-DIGIAUD): discontinued end 2023
notes: Description: This minor develops your foundational knowledge and skills necessary to do critical research (industry or academic) on digital media platforms and audiences.
*Note: CCB200, CCB301, CCB302, CYB105 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2023 or earlier.

semesters.name: Digital Media Management (KKBXMNR-DIGIMAN): discontinued end 2023
notes: Description: This minor provides you with the opportunity to acquire basic practical skills in digital media management, including content creation and design.
*Note: CCB102, CCB200, CYB104 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2023 or earlier.

semesters.name: Drama (KKBXMNR-DRAMA): discontinued end 2024
notes: Description: This minor provides you with the introductory knowledge, theory, and performing skills that underpin performance-making across popular and contemporary genres.
*Note: KTB110, KTB111, KTB120, KTB121 and KTB217 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.

semesters.name: Entertainment (KKBXMNR-ENTMENT - version 4): discontinued end 2023
notes: Description: This minor provides you with an understanding of content producing industries, like film and television, at a time when methods of production, distribution, and consumption are undergoing tremendous change.
*Note: CDB101,CDB202, CYB102, CYB105, CYB106 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2023 or earlier.

semesters.name: Fashion Communication (KKBXMNR-FASHION): discontinued end 2018
notes: Description: This minor will provide you with diverse knowledge and understanding how the dissemination of fashion is communicated globally.

semesters.name: Interaction Design (DEBXMNR-INTERDN): discontinued end 2026

units.title: Principles of Interaction and UX Design

notes: Description: This minor aims to provide you with a foundational understanding of the design concepts and principles of interaction design and practical skills and methods needed by a contemporary designer of digital and physical interactive products, including an introduction to user-centred design, user experience design, creative coding, web design and prototyping as well as tangible and experiential media.

semesters.name: Interiors (DEBXMNR-INTERIO): discontinued end 2023
notes: Description: This minor will introduce you to interior design practices and knowledge and may complement your own discipline and allow you to work more effectively with interior designers in professional practice.
*Note: DTB101, DTB102, DTB205, DTB304, DYB111 and DYB113 are permitted to count towards this Minor if completed in 2023 or earlier.

semesters.name: Journalism (KKBXMNR-JOURN): discontinued end 2023
notes: Description: This minor will introduce you to a range of key journalistic principles, approaches and writing styles.
*Note:CJB201 and CJB202 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.
*Note:CJB102 and CJB103 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2023 or earlier.

semesters.name: Landscape Design (DEBXMNR-LNDDES): discontinued end 2023
notes: Description: This minor will introduce you to landscape design knowledge and may complement your own discipline.
*Note: DLB101, DLB102, DLB202, DLB204 and DYB111 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2023 or earlier
*Note: DLB211 is permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2020 or earlier.

semesters.name: Landscape Architecture Studies (DEBXMNR-LNDARCH): discontinued end 2018
notes: Description: This minor will introduce you to landscape architecture practices and knowledge and may complement your own discipline and allow you to work more effectively with landscape architects in professional practice.
*Note: DLB101, DLB102, DLB201, DLB202, DLB204, DLB301, DLB302, DYB111 and DYB114 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2023 or earlier.
*Note: DLB211, DLB400 and DLB525 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2020 or earlier.

semesters.name: Music (KKBXMNR-MUSIC): discontinued end 2024

units.title: Composition and Sound Design in Digital Environments

notes: Description: The Music minor aims to impart a broad understanding of music practice in contemporary social, cultural and economic contexts and to provide you with a combination of practical and theoretical technological skills to support a career in music through creative, administrative, and business pathways.
*Note: KMB118 and KMB222 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.

semesters.name: Screen Studies (KKBXMNR-SCRNSTD): discontinued end 2024
notes: Description: The screen studies minor will develop critical literacy skills in terms of critical writing, analytical and research skills in relation to screen histories, industries, texts and audiences. The minor will provide students with a deep understanding of feature film, television, documentary and screen media, and the ability to critically analyse, research and interpret the impact, structures and the transformation of screen media and their influence in relation to everyday life and social and cultural contexts.
*Note: KPB120 is permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.

semesters.name: Scriptwriting for Interactive Environments (KKBXMNR-SCRWRIT): discontinued end 2024

units.title: Introduction to Screen Production: Single Camera

notes: Description: The aim of this minor is to provide you with a broad understanding of writing for interactive environments through the combination of units that look at writing for different screen formats.
*Note: KNB127, KNB136, KNB137 and KPB101 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.

semesters.name: Visual Arts Practice (KKBXMNR-VISARTS): discontinued end 2024
notes: Description: You will develop fundamental skills in 2D, 3D, photo, and time-based media while also building your capacity to develop works of art independently that are informed by research into 20th and 21st century art and ideas. This minor is designed to complement creative activities undertaken in other study areas by building your awareness of media, composition and process.
*Note: KVB104, KVB110, and KVB222 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.

semesters.name: Work Integrated Learning (WIL) (KKBXMNR-WKILRNG): discontinued end 2024
notes: Description: This minor will allow you to undertake a series of industry-focused units that involve structured work experiences via internships, professional projects or study tours. These units are designed to encourage you to learn within your chosen profession at an industry standard and offer professional experience, guided by academic objectives, for academic credit.

*You may select either KKB345, KKB346 or KKB350 provided there is a design-focused project or tour available in the relevant semester. It will not be possible to enrol in KKB346 unless you have completed KKB345 in another study package.
Note: KKB346 Creative Industries Project 2, KKB351 Work Integrated Learning 3, KKB352 Work Integrated Learning 4 are permitted to count towards this study area if completed in 2024 or earlier.

Your study will include practical investigation into the step-by-step theatre design process, including textual analysis and communication of design concepts, and realised performance projects.
Note: This minor is only available to students from Creative Industries single degrees and IF27 students.

semesters.name: Social Media Strategy (KCBXMNR-SOCMEDS)

semesters.name: Strategic Communication for the Professions (KCBXMNR-STRPROF)
notes: Description: Strategic Communication is a versatile minor that equips you with the skills to communicate effectively in a variety of organisational and professional settings. The minor prepares you to conceive, prepare, and deliver functional communication forms, like briefings and reports, and more persuasive messages, like strategic speech writing and delivery. You learn how to use communication to influence opinion, adapt messages for different audiences, and critically evaluate the effectiveness of different communication tools, platforms, and approaches. The minor is a great complement to any study plan as communication skills and strategic thinking are highly sought after by employers in any industry.

semesters.name: Architectural Studies (DEBXMNR-ARCSTUD - version 2): discontinued end 2023

semesters.name: Art and Design History (KKBXMNR-ARTDESH): discontinued end 2024
notes: Description: This minor introduces you to the essential principles of visual and textual literacy. semesters.name: CGI (KKBXMNR-CGENI): discontinued end 2024

semesters.name: Character Animation (KKBXMNR-CHARANI): discontinued end 2024

semesters.name: Communication for the Professions (KKBXMNR-COMNPRF): discontinued end 2023

semesters.name: Dance (KKBXMNR-DANCE): discontinued end 2024

semesters.name: Screen Studies (KKBXMNR-SCRNSTD): discontinued end 2024
notes: Description: The screen studies minor will develop critical literacy skills in terms of critical writing, analytical and research skills in relation to screen histories, industries, texts and audiences. semesters.name: Scriptwriting for Interactive Environments (KKBXMNR-SCRWRIT): discontinued end 2024

units.title: Introduction to Screen Production: Single Camera

notes: Description: The aim of this minor is to provide you with a broad understanding of writing for interactive environments through the combination of units that look at writing for different screen formats.

semesters.name: Visual Arts Practice (KKBXMNR-VISARTS): discontinued end 2024
notes: Description: You will develop fundamental skills in 2D, 3D, photo, and time-based media while also building your capacity to develop works of art independently that are informed by research into 20th and 21st century art and ideas. *Note: KVB104, KVB110, and KVB222 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.

semesters.name: Work Integrated Learning (WIL) (KKBXMNR-WKILRNG): discontinued end 2024
notes: Description: This minor will allow you to undertake a series of industry-focused units that involve structured work experiences via internships, professional projects or study tours. *You may select either KKB345, KKB346 or KKB350 provided there is a design-focused project or tour available in the relevant semester. It will not be possible to enrol in KKB346 unless you have completed KKB345 in another study package.
Note: KKB346 Creative Industries Project 2, KKB351 Work Integrated Learning 3, KKB352 Work Integrated Learning 4 are permitted to count towards this study area if completed in 2024 or earlier.

semesters.name: Scenography (KKFAMNR-SCENEGR)
notes: Description: This minor will provide you with the practical and theoretical skills associated with the creation of scenography for theatre and live performance. You will investigate some of the theatrical and cultural shifts throughout history that underpin current approaches to design for theatre, dance, opera and contemporary live performance. Your study will include practical investigation into the step-by-step theatre design process, including textual analysis and communication of design concepts, and realised performance projects.
Note: This minor is only available to students from Creative Industries single degrees and IF27 students.

notes: Select 24cp from the Social Media Strategy minor core options list:

semesters.name: Strategic Communication for the Professions (KCBXMNR-STRPROF)
notes: Description: Strategic Communication is a versatile minor that equips you with the skills to communicate effectively in a variety of organisational and professional settings. The minor prepares you to conceive, prepare, and deliver functional communication forms, like briefings and reports, and more persuasive messages, like strategic speech writing and delivery. You learn how to use communication to influence opinion, adapt messages for different audiences, and critically evaluate the effectiveness of different communication tools, platforms, and approaches. The minor is a great complement to any study plan as communication skills and strategic thinking are highly sought after by employers in any industry.

semesters.name: Architectural Studies (DEBXMNR-ARCSTUD - version 2): discontinued end 2023
notes: Description: This minor will introduce you to architectural practices and knowledge and may complement your own discipline and allow you to work more effectively with architects in professional practice.

semesters.name: Art and Design History (KKBXMNR-ARTDESH): discontinued end 2024
notes: Description: This minor introduces you to the essential principles of visual and textual literacy. You will develop the fundamental skills of learning, discussing and writing about the history and theory of visual art, architecture and design and understand the historical and contextual frameworks of creative practice in these fields.
*Note: KVB102 and KVB113 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.

*Note: KNB127 and KNB137 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.

*Note: DLB101, DLB102, DLB201, DLB202, DLB204, DLB301, DLB302, DYB111 and DYB114 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2023 or earlier.
*Note: DLB211, DLB400 and DLB525 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2020 or earlier.

semesters.name: Music (KKBXMNR-MUSIC): discontinued end 2024

units.title: Composition and Sound Design in Digital Environments

notes: Description: The Music minor aims to impart a broad understanding of music practice in contemporary social, cultural and economic contexts and to provide you with a combination of practical and theoretical technological skills to support a career in music through creative, administrative, and business pathways.
*Note: KMB118 and KMB222 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.

semesters.name: Screen Studies (KKBXMNR-SCRNSTD): discontinued end 2024
notes: Description: The screen studies minor will develop critical literacy skills in terms of critical writing, analytical and research skills in relation to screen histories, industries, texts and audiences. The minor will provide students with a deep understanding of feature film, television, documentary and screen media, and the ability to critically analyse, research and interpret the impact, structures and the transformation of screen media and their influence in relation to everyday life and social and cultural contexts.
*Note: KPB120 is permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.

semesters.name: Scriptwriting for Interactive Environments (KKBXMNR-SCRWRIT): discontinued end 2024

units.title: Introduction to Screen Production: Single Camera

notes: Description: The aim of this minor is to provide you with a broad understanding of writing for interactive environments through the combination of units that look at writing for different screen formats.
*Note: KNB127, KNB136, KNB137 and KPB101 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.

semesters.name: Visual Arts Practice (KKBXMNR-VISARTS): discontinued end 2024
notes: Description: You will develop fundamental skills in 2D, 3D, photo, and time-based media while also building your capacity to develop works of art independently that are informed by research into 20th and 21st century art and ideas. This minor is designed to complement creative activities undertaken in other study areas by building your awareness of media, composition and process.
*Note: KVB104, KVB110, and KVB222 are permitted to count towards this minor if completed in 2024 or earlier.

semesters.name: Work Integrated Learning (WIL) (KKBXMNR-WKILRNG): discontinued end 2024
notes: Description: This minor will allow you to undertake a series of industry-focused units that involve structured work experiences via internships, professional projects or study tours. These units are designed to encourage you to learn within your chosen profession at an industry standard and offer professional experience, guided by academic objectives, for academic credit.

*You may select either KKB345, KKB346 or KKB350 provided there is a design-focused project or tour available in the relevant semester. It will not be possible to enrol in KKB346 unless you have completed KKB345 in another study package.
Note: KKB346 Creative Industries Project 2, KKB351 Work Integrated Learning 3, KKB352 Work Integrated Learning 4 are permitted to count towards this study area if completed in 2024 or earlier.
